verdict.rationale: vLLM's own docs state that it manages attention key/value memory with PagedAttention, which is the paged KV-cache capability this story asks for. Community comments confirm that vLLM's KV cache and paged attention are core to the product and used in production. missing for 10: first-party detail explaining how paging avoids memory fragmentation, evidence quantifying the gain in concurrent request capacity, independent hands-on benchmarks of memory efficiency.

support.subject: As a developer, I can rely on paged memory management for attention key/value cache to maximize concurrent request capacity without memory fragmentation

citations.quote: Efficient management of attention key and value memory with PagedAttention
vLLM is originally marketed as paged attention
We use vLLM kv cache and continuous batching as a foundation for requests in ScalarLM
